products.name: S.Space
products.tagline: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace
products.description: Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

products.name: Bluedot Phone Calls
products.tagline: AI note taker for phone calls
products.description: Bluedot now covers phone calls, not just meetings. Dial from the web or mobile app, keep your own caller ID, and get a transcript, summary and action items automatically.

products.name: Toone
products.description: Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. Plus live share, meeting notes, Spotlight-style layouts, Zen Mode, Calendar, Quick Capture, Git, and MCPs for research, SEO and more.

products.name: Waldo by Wherobots
products.tagline: The AI agent that accelerates engineering with spatial data
products.description: Waldo is the geospatial data agent that turns questions about the physical world into answers, maps, and production-ready data pipelines. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

products.name: Dippr
products.tagline: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt
products.description: It’s where your agents build and run your company’s software, tools and apps – with access to your company data across sources, the context to understand it, and the rules to use it safely.

products.name: Pitch Avatar HR Suite
products.tagline: Onboarding, training & comms with conversational AI avatars
products.description: HR teams should be talking to people. Instead, up to 70% of the day goes to onboarding, mandatory training, and the same questions again and again, with no way to tell what works. HR Suite automates it with conversational AI avatars. They teach from your materials and answer employees’ questions in lessons and as an HR assistant. Reminders keep people on track; HR sees who finished and where they got stuck. Free 14-day trial + 50% off any plan with code PRODUCTHUNT2026 until Nov 30.

products.name: Mermaid Flow
products.tagline: The visual builder for agentic workflows
products.description: Mermaid Flow lets you build agentic workflows as diagrams, then run them. Think issue triage, weekly recaps, PR reviews: work you'd otherwise hand to a long prompt or a skill file. Describe what you want, start from a template, or bring the file, and you get a workflow with every step laid out. Connect Github, Slack, Notion, and more in one click, then hit run or put it on a schedule. Every run is saved step by step, so you can see what happened and your team can follow along. Free to start.

products.name: dusk bot
products.tagline: free open source Grok bot alternative
products.description: Best free Grok bot alternative. Use the ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan you already pay for and get a team of bots, each with a job, a memory you can edit and its own computer. They run on a schedule, ask before risky steps, and live in a calm, polished chat app. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter or a local model, on your own sign-in. 100% free and open source

products.name: Review Box
products.tagline: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests
products.description: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. Track reviewed files, jump to symbol definitions and uses, search the whole PR and ask AI about changes.

products.name: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
products.tagline: Two new OpenAI models: frontier Astra and efficient Sol
products.description: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are OpenAI’s new models for professional work. Astra is the frontier model for the hardest projects, like slides, websites, 3D designs and science research. Sol is the efficient everyday model for coding and multistep agent work. Per OpenAI, Astra costs under a third per task of GPT-6 Astra. API pricing per million tokens: Astra $8 in, $40 out; Sol $2 in, $10 out. Live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, plus the API.

products.name: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
products.tagline: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you
products.description: Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

products.name: Incredible Agents
products.tagline: Fast Voice AI that sees your screen and runs your agents
products.description: The heavily asked for INCREDIBLE AGENTS update is finally here! Your voice can now: (1) CREATE new agents that work directly on your computer, in apps, browsers and files. (2) RUN work on repeat, 24/7. (3) BUILD live sharable pages, dashboards, apps and more. Incredible PROACTIVELY FINDS WORK AI agents can do for you, and sets the agent up. Agents do the work directly on your computer, the way you do, 24/7. FREE TO TRY. Mac and Windows.

products.name: Tencent Hy4 flash
products.description: Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

products.name: uRun
products.tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
products.description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

products.name: Replay QA Self-healing Mode
products.tagline: Turn user frustration into verified fixes
products.description: Self-healing Mode turns frustrated user sessions into root-caused bug reports with evidence, sent to your issue tracker or straight to your coding agent. - always-on user session capture (powered by Fullstory) - automatic detection of user frustration signals - Bug reports with detailed root-cause analysis + runtime evidence - pipe them into your issue tracker of choice or straight to your coding agent or factory loop - Daily summary reports of what users did
